'''2003 DPC Chicago''' was the Chicago DPC Championship, a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament played on 12 April 2003 at Pastimes, 8478 Golf Road, Niles, Illinois, during the DeckTech Player's Challenge weekend of 11–13 April 2003. It was the first event of the Players Committee's DPC Championship Series, co-sponsored by DeckTech, and "the first DPC in the Midwest" since the inaugural DeckTech Player's Challenge in Normal, Illinois, which drew "80+ players".<ref name="pc-dpcchi">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030418001540/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/dpcchicago.htm DPC Goes Back to it's Roots; Next Stop is the Windy City!], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 18 April 2003.</ref> [[Andrew Howard]] directed it; the entry fee was $20.<ref name="pc-events03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031009215036/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2003 Events], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 9 October 2003.</ref> [[Justin Desai]] won and $500; Desai and [[Brian Fred]] qualified for Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-may03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031229115404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/may03archives.htm May 03 Updates: DPC Chicago Finalist's Decks Posted! (2 May 2003)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 29 December 2003.</ref><ref name="pc-events03" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Pastimes, 8478 Golf Road, Niles, Illinois<ref name="pc-dpcchi" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Andrew Howard]]<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Players:''' 25 (24 after one drop)<ref name="pcf-1296">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040323102139/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1296&amp Live Coverage UPDATE #3], Andrew Howard (12 April 2003), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 23 March 2004.</ref><ref name="pcf-1297">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040131132742/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1297&amp Live Coverage UPDATE #4], Andrew Howard (12 April 2003), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 31 January 2004.</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 12 April 2003

== Results ==

The Players Committee posted the top 4 with their prizes.<ref name="pc-may03" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Place !! Player !! Prize
|-
| 1st || [[Justin Desai]] || $500
|-
| 2nd || [[Brian Fred]] || $220
|-
| 3rd || [[Brian Hunter]] || $120
|-
| 4th || [[Clint Hays]] || $60
|}

Andrew Howard's live coverage on the PC forums reported that the event "Started with 25 players, less than the expected turnout".<ref name="pcf-1296" /> After four rounds the top tables stood: Justin Desai 8 (+80), Brian Fred 8 (+53), [[Ryan Fojtik|Ryan Fojitk]] 6 (+62), [[Jonny Chu|Jonathan Chu]] 6 (+59), Brian Hunter 6 (+40) and [[Eric Olson]] 6.<ref name="pcf-1297" /> After five rounds Desai was the only undefeated player; the decks seen included DS Senate and LS Lightsaber Combat (Desai, [[Mike Gemme]]), DS Combat and Throne Room Mains (Chu, [[Clint Hays]]), Local Uprising (V) speeders (Hunter, Fred), Dark Deal (Fred), MKOS Scum (Hunter), Rops and EBO (Olson), RTP (James Beyer), TIE Bombers ([[Frank Amador]]), WYS and Senate (Edmund Gray), and Watto and QMC (Fojitk).<ref name="pcf-1299">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040131132845/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1299&amp Live Coverage UPDATE #5], Andrew Howard (12 April 2003), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 31 January 2004.</ref> The Players Committee linked decklist PDFs for all eight top-4 decks; only Desai's Dark list has been preserved.<ref name="pc-may03" />

== Side events ==

The weekend schedule had a Star Wars CCG Classic Format event on Friday 11 April ($5, with free entry into the DPC Championship) and an SWCCG Team Tournament ($25) on Sunday.<ref name="pc-dpcchi" /> The Friday [[Classic]] event drew 6 players and was won undefeated by [[Jonny Chu|Jonathan Chu]] with SYCFA Brangus and Local Uprising (V) Ketwol.<ref name="pcf-1295">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040131131102/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1295&amp Live Coverage UPDATE #1], Andrew Howard (11 April 2003), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 31 January 2004.</ref>
